items.title: IBM and Lockheed Martin Seem an Odd Couple. Why They’re Teaming Up On Quantum.
items.summary: International Business Machines  and  Lockheed Martin  might seem like an unlikely pairing, but the storied tech giant and defense titan share common ground: quantum computing.  The companies are taking their existing partnership a step further with the formation of a quantum innovation hub in Switzerland, IBM and Lockheed announced Thursday.  At the heart of the agreement is the deployment of an IBM Quantum System Two, the latest generation of the company’s flagship quantum computer, which will be accessible to academics, researchers, and enterprises in the country.

items.title: Is Accenture's Business Falling As Fast As Its Stock?
items.summary: Accenture (ACN) trades at $179.03, about 53% below its two-year high, the price of a business the market thinks is ending. Over the last twelve months, it generated $12.58 billion of free cash flow, a yield of 11.5% on its market value against a 4.4% median for the S&P 500. Both facts are true. The argument between them is about growth.
